description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain key extension functionality, specifically testing compound key behavior, validation, and retrieval mechanisms within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: KeyExtensionTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans grain key extension behaviors in multi-tenancy and key validation scenarios.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldDifferentiateGrainsUsingTheSameBasePrimaryKey
methods.description: Verifies that grains with the same base primary key but different key extensions are treated as distinct instances.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldDifferentiateGrainsUsingDifferentBaseKeys
methods.description: Ensures grains with different base keys are distinct, even if key extensions are the same.

methods.name: EmptyKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Checks that empty string key extensions are not permitted for grain keys.

methods.name: WhiteSpaceKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Checks that whitespace-only key extensions are rejected.

methods.name: NullKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Ensures passing null as a key extension throws an exception.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldPermitStringsLongerThan127BytesLong
methods.description: Verifies long string key extensions are accepted and correctly handled.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyStringOnGrainReference
methods.description: Checks extraction of primary key string from a grain reference.
